name: Sorimachi Kikuna
source:
A third-year student. She is the head of the school's public morals committee and is an inflexible stiff.

She is a fastidious virgin who feels uncomfortable just imagining kissing or petting. She is adored as a big sister in the school.

[From [url=http://www.masterup.net/hina-soft/moe_hina/haramase/index.html]official site[/url]]
